messages:
Jordan (PM): Penned the company-level OKR draft for FY25 Q3. Please review and sign off by Friday EOD. Full draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/OKR-Q3-DRAFT
Sam (CEO): Thanks — high level looks good. One ask: call out blocking dependencies for Dedicated 2.0 launch (infra, legal, partners).
Jordan (PM): Will do. Off the top: infra delivery by M-6, partner APAC onboarding confirmed, kernel tuning within 3 sprints. Blockers: legal/terms for Dedicated, and any perf regressions >5%.
Chris (CTO): Add to blockers: autoscaler feature parity. Also concerned about setting availability SLO <99.9 before autoscaler GA.
Anne (Product): Re: Objective A KR1 where we list `p95 <100ms` for hosted small-tier — that's likely optimistic given current traffic mix. Propose `p95 <150ms` and separate KR for p50.
Maria (Eng): +1. Also request adding a tech-debt KR: "Reduce runtime memory leaks -> <1 OOM per 10k sessions". We had 3 production OOM reports last month during 50+ turn chats.
Lee (Finance): From finance POV, revenue KRs should be phased. Suggest milestones: 20% commit by month 1, 50% by month 2, 80% by month 3. Helps cashflow planning.
Jordan (PM): Updating KRs now. Also drafting a launch-criteria checklist: (1) perf SLOs stable for 10 business days in staging, (2) security audit passed, (3) rollout + rollback runbook rehearsed.
DevOps Bot: Checklist created: https://ci.redwood.local/job/dedicated-2.0/checklist. Note: automated smoke tests must pass in canary step.
Sam (CEO): If we relax p95 to 150ms, pricing premium for Dedicated should reflect that. We shouldn't promise a top-tier premium for lower perf. @Anne can you model pricing deltas?
Chris (CTO): I can accept 150ms p95 provided we publish a performance roadmap (milestones + ETA) and include an SLA tier matrix for customers.
Anne (Product): I'll draft the SLA tier table + suggested price bands. Expect upload by Wednesday.
Maria (Eng): For rollout, propose Canary ramp: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback triggers: error rate >0.5% or latency drift >15% over baseline. Add health check: `kv_cache_miss_rate < 2%`.
Jordan (PM): Added Canary plan and rollback triggers to the doc. Also created a short customer comms checklist (support scripts + troubleshooting FAQ).
Lee (Finance): Last ask: map each KR to an expected MRR impact or ops delta so execs can justify headcount/infra spend in the review deck.
Sam (CEO): Clear owners: Jordan finalizes doc and runs sign-off, Anne owns pricing/SLA, Chris owns perf/availability sign-off, Lee validates finances, Maria owns rollout/runbook. Deadline: Friday EOD for final approval.
Jordan (PM): I'll circulate the updated draft this afternoon and tag remaining open items.
Anne (Product): Uploaded initial SLA/pricing sketch: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/SLA-Q3. Ping me with objections. :thumbsup:
Chris (CTO): Running quick perf risk assessment now. Will post findings + a short mitigation plan by Thursday.
Maria (Eng): Scheduling a 30-min dry-run of rollback with eng-oncall for Thursday 11am. Calendar invite incoming.
Sam (CEO): Great. Please keep substantive discussion inline in the doc; use Slack threads for quick clarifications only. Thanks team — if all thumbs up by Friday I will send final sign-off. :rocket:
